BiblicalUsage: Gob is a place in Palestine. In 2 Samuel 21:18, the text says "that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob." It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Gob matters because God's story happened in real places, and Gob is one of them.
